paper.title: Exactly solved model of self-organized critical phenomena

headline: Directed abelian sandpile 1989 (CA): 2/3 locked clauses REPRO; discrete-MLE tau=1.391 (exact 4/3), avalanche anisotropy longitudinal/transverse=2.00x, sizes span 4.9 decades with max/median=15740x

verdicts.gate: P1 tail exponent: mean discrete-MLE tau in [1.2, 1.5] (exact Dhar-Ramaswamy 4/3~=1.333)
P2 anisotropy: mean longitudinal extent >= 2.0x mean transverse extent
reasons: mean anisotropy ratio = 1.9987 (per-seed [1.955, 2.071]; mean longitudinal 15.51 vs transverse 7.76) < 2.0x

verdicts.gate: P3 heavy tail: sizes span >= 2.0 decades AND max >= 100.0x median nonzero

extra.rule: directed abelian toppling: a cell at height >= 2 sheds 2 grains DOWNWARD to the two down-diagonal neighbours (y+1, x) and (y+1, (x+1) mod W); transverse periodic, bottom row open (dissipative); abelian (order-independent) toppling verified against a naive single-cell relaxation
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published exactly-solvable SOC model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the Dhar-Ramaswamy directed sandpile's exact tail exponent tau=4/3, its directional avalanche anisotropy, and its heavy-tailed size distribution, and would catch an artifact

citations: Dhar, D. & Ramaswamy, R. (1989). Exactly solved model of self-organized critical phenomena. Physical Review Letters 63(16):1659-1662. doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.63.1659.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the Dhar-Ramaswamy directed sandpile (exact tail exponent tau=4/3, avalanche anisotropy, heavy-tailed sizes)
